body:
code like this 

```python
qk = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N], dtype=tl.float16)

for ...:
    qk += tl.where(mask, tl.dot(q, k, out_dtype=tl.float16), 0.0)
```

would trigger 

```text
AssertionError('initial value for `qk` is of type <[64, 64], fp16>, but the then block redefines it as <[64, 64], fp32>')
```

So how to represent numeric literals in fp16 or other type? 

Besides, why `tl.where` does not maintain type consistence of the two candidates?
title: how to use numeric literal in fp16
